5972-6054-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5972-6054-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5972-6054-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-4779-5060-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5060-5131--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-4779-5060-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

277-1308-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1619-2511-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2511-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3499-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6835-6972.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

14-141-997.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

1170-1329-3480-3518.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

5220-5231-5946.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5946.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
5220-5231-5946.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

224-277-3147-3314-3430.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {W} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-277-3147-3314-3430.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it, Tiller Engine and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2100-5644.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

1274-1545-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1545-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2054-3525-5149-5516.easyPrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
Power Artifact attached to Urn of Godfire.
2054-3525-5149-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
2054-3525-5149-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

710-1258-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2267-5477-5629-5630.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2267-5477-5629-5630.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself on top of your library.
Tormod and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Snarling Gorehound triggers, causing you to surveil 1, putting Moss-Pit Skeleton into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton and Snarling Gorehound trigger.
Resolve the Snarling Gorehound trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger, putting it on top of your library.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1817-2232.notablePrerequisites: Two additional nonartifact permanent cards on the battlefield that share a type.
1479-1817-2232.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree by paying {4}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell except it isn't legendary.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio; decline to use this ability unless desired.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and the token Kodama of the East Tree; decline to use these abilities unless desired.
Play the nonartifact permanent in your hand.
When it enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and both copies of Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other nonartifact permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the first Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the permanent you returned in step 7 from your hand onto the battlefield.
When that permanent enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and the second Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the permanent you played in step 5 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 9, declining to use it unless desired.
Resolve the remaining Kodama of the East Tree trigger from step 6, putting the permanent you returned in step 10 from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
This combo results in Infinite ETB and Infinite LTB if a permanent involved is a creature, and/or Infinite landfall triggers if it is a land.

277-1227-1669-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
277-1227-1669-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ordeal of Nylea, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing the Ordeal of Nylea token.
The Ordeal of Nylea token's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers twice, untapping them.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability from step 2, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

224-539-3661-5094-5196.notablePrerequisites: Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-3661-5094-5196.description:
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's second ability by tapping it, returning Shield Sphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

1642-3011.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
1642-3011.description:
Activate Heartless HIdetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent with an even life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2645-3291.notablePrerequisites: Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness. Your devotion to green is at least five.
2645-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
